source_read: https://www.benscookies.com/nutritional-information/ and https://www.benscookies.com/allergens/ (both fetched fresh 2026-10-09; benscookies.com robots.txt allows both; the pages were read rendered in headless Chromium, not through our HTML parser)
notes: All 28 table rows (27 published + Rum & Raisin held back) compared on 14 values each (kcal, kJ, protein, fat, saturates, mono, poly, trans, carbs, sugars, fibre, sodium, salt, 85 g size): 392/392 identical. Allergens: all 28 'Allergens' cells match allergens.csv (contains + wheat/oats), and the 26 per-cookie cards on the allergens page match both contains and may-contain; the only difference is that the six cookies with a named tree nut keep 'nuts' in contains and not in may-contain (the guide prints 'may contain other nuts'; the data contract cannot hold a key in both columns), so the app shows generic tree nuts as contained. Rum & Raisin hold confirmed (422.5 kcal vs 1621 kJ = 387 kcal and macros 387 kcal; every other row's kJ and macros agree within 2%). Re-running tools/uk_extract/bens_cookies.py on the fresh pages reproduces data/source/bens-cookies byte for byte; check_chain: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 audit flags. Orange & Dark Chocolate has an allergen card but no nutrition row, so it is not published.
